segments.name: development and licensing of biopharmaceutical assets
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical royalty company that invests in and licenses technologies to acquire diversified royalty streams from high-value medicines commercialized by partners.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating and one reportable segment: development and licensing of biopharmaceutical assets.

revenueModel.text: Ligand is paid by biopharmaceutical partners primarily through royalties on sales of commercialized products, supplemented by Captisol material sales and contract revenue from license fees and milestone payments.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is generated primarily from royalties on sales of products commercialized by our partners, supplemented by Captisol material sales and contract revenue from license fees and milestone payments.

changes.text: In 2022, Ligand spun off its OmniAb antibody discovery business, which was classified as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: The Company determined that the spin-off of the OmniAb Business in November 2022 in connection with the OmniAb Transactions met the criteria for classification as a discontinued operation in accordance with ASC Subtopic 205-20, Discontinued Operations ("ASC 205-20").

changes.text: In 2023, Ligand spun off its Pelican Expression Technology subsidiary.
